services.name: Yoga in the Garden
services.desc: Join Yoga expert Melissa Feinberg for a gentle discovery within the practice of Yoga. Beginner or advanced students will begin with a warmup and introduction then move onto discovering new postures, breathing and meditation practices. Yoga’s many potential benefits include improved flexibility, strength and body awareness. It may also help relieve stress and anxiety. Registration is required. Suggested donation of $10 to cover program expenses. 2610 Route 35, Katonah, N.Y. 10536 Lasdon Public Gardens & Veterans Memorial is owned and operated by Westchester County Parks.
